_source: UNI2 1.42 IDB C:\dev\ida\server\uni2_142_4ebed985.exe.i64, traced 2026-10-17 from each path string's xref to the opening function and up its callers. First matching regex wins (posix path relative to the data dir).

sites.when: single/story mode, when a character's talk starts (callers 0x824530/0x824880 <- 0x824AC0; exact scene of 0x824AC0 not confirmed)
sites.consumer: talk scene player (CBtlTalk); path copied to byte_9EFF28

sites.when: story mode scene (vtable method, no direct caller)
win demo scene (sub_635680 <- Scene_DispatchUpdate 0x5CB3D0; also WinnerDemo_LoadWinmes 0x84C110 <- WinnerDemo_LoadResources 0x84BC40)
sites.consumer: win quote display dword_9EFEAC, cg_image_font / message_line_cg textures

sites.when: character select, when an arcade/story route is picked (0x581420/0x581470/0x5814C0 <- CharaSelect_UpdateStateMachine 0x650C90)
sites.consumer: Sq_RunScriptFile in a new CSquirrel -> BattleTable_BuildFromSq 0x5673C0 (stage table; name from call shape)

sites.when: chara load (Chara_LoadBattleScripts 0x645E50, directly and through sub_590130)
sites.consumer: TrainingCmdList_ReadFile 0x590770 -> TrainingCmdList_ParseText 0x5903C0 -> command list vector dword_9A599C..9A59A0 (dword_9A5998 = chara)

sites.when: replay save after a VS match (sub_857910 <- sub_85B8A0)
sites.consumer: replay header template, expanded by Replay_ExpandHeaderTemplate 0x622360 into ./Replay/<1PNAME>x<2PNAME>_<date>.rep

sites.when: boot (App_InitGraphicsAndShaders 0x8DEFE0 <- WinMain; name from call shape)
sites.consumer: Shader_LoadTechnique 0x4AEE00(file, slot, technique) -> D3DX effect slots (sh_chara, sh_paniblur, sh_panimask, sh_blur, sh_mono, sh_talkmono, sh_bgobject, sh_bgspeculer, bg.txt, bg1_1..bg11_11)

sites.when: character select (sub_64FF80 <- sub_64BA70) and single mode (sub_826890 <- sub_824880); dir from CharaRes_BuildCselColorEditDir 0x6490C0
sites.consumer: CharaRes_LoadOrGetCached: csel_<chr>.txt / edit_<chr>.txt for the character select and colour edit screens

untraced.System/str_jp/*.csv and other System fil: each CSV has its own loader (Customize*, Gallery*, SingleMode*, Option* screens), seen in the string dump but not followed; boot ones (DLC.csv, global_replace_word.csv, key_guide_replace_word.csv) come from Boot_LoadGlobalResources 0x8DD0F0; LanguageFirstPathList.csv via SearchPath_ReloadLanguageSlots 0x8A7EF0, _sysfont.ini 0x8A76A0, stringfile.csv 0x82CBA0
untraced.BattleTable strings at 0x566DF3 / 0x5676: references outside any defined function, not followed
